council.integrator_rule: The integrator reconstructs decisive claims from pinned primary sources, adjudicates every objection, and owns the final scope. Agent agreement, confidence, and role labels cannot upgrade an evidence class.

roles.independence_limit: Same root environment, shared source corpus, and shared repository context; this is an integrator judgment, not institutional independence.
roles.scope: PrimeGaps theorem and artifact reconstruction, PID context mapping, 20-lens adjudication, and final claim calibration.

roles.independence_limit: Read-only source audit used the same public repository and provider surfaces as the integrator.
roles.scope: Exact PrimeGaps source, proof-document graph, certificate, history, workflow, and hosted-run inventory.

roles.independence_limit: Same model family and local custody; separately recomputed finite SxPID3 algebra but did not supply external human review.
roles.scope: SxPID3 exact formulas, semantic mass DAG, reduced-rational plan, Lean/SMT/Rust route design, shard completeness, and nontransfer firewall.

roles.independence_limit: Same institution, model lineage, and filesystem; dissent improves local error discovery but is not external custody.
roles.scope: Attack semantic analogy, novelty, statistical and continuous overreach, existing-work duplication, evidence quality, and durability.

design_decisions.reason: It preserves the provenance of N, T, U, and V mass occurrences, exposes missing and orphan semantic routes, and supports a proved evaluation bridge without merging different events merely because their numeric counts coincide.
required_controls: Exact frozen event and stable antichain keys.
Forward completeness from every required occurrence to one graph route.
Backward soundness from every reachable graph node to one required semantic occurrence.
Rejection of numeric aliasing across semantically different masses.
Independent reconstruction from canonical count-table bytes.
Equivalence and time, memory, and certificate-size benchmarks against the existing direct exact route.
design_decisions.scope: Internal assurance representation for empirical categorical three-source shared exclusions.

design_decisions.reason: Arithmetic cancellation and exact sign require aggregation by reduced positive-rational value, while semantic identity requires a separate origin graph. One dictionary cannot safely serve both roles.
required_controls: Direct net ratio equals informative ratio divided by misinformative ratio.
Exact integer exponents after count clearing.
Exact product comparison with one after preflight.
Nonsyntactic product-one and negative-net mutations.
Origin digest remains separate from arithmetic normalization.
design_decisions.scope: All 54 cumulative and 54 atom exact-product plans in SxPID3.

design_decisions.reason: The DAG may instantiate the existing proposed revision only while certificate fields, coordinate semantics, normalization, and resource admission remain unchanged. Acceptance-bearing graph fields or changed limits alter the claim and require re-adjudication.
required_controls: Compare the implementation against the frozen revision-1 resource policy.
Keep graph details internal unless a new schema and claim revision are approved.
Bind the producer and verifier to the same public mathematical coordinate registry without shared load-bearing code.

design_decisions.reason: The 20,348-table, 2,197,584-verdict corpus needs explicit half-open coverage, adjacency, no-overlap, common source identity, and terminal completion rather than one opaque long process or expiring CI artifact.
required_controls: Canonical count-vector ordinal.
Half-open shard ranges with first and last keys.
Identical claim, source, schema, toolchain, binary, and input identities.
Root proof of sorted adjacency and exact totals.
Raw shard digest or Merkle root and retained failure shards.
design_decisions.scope: Bounded binary SxPID3 qualification corpus only.

design_decisions.reason: PrimeGaps packing solves a demonstrated large exact-computation problem. SxPID3 should first use the simplest auditable streaming checker and add custom packing only after profiling under the frozen resource contract.
required_controls: A correct uncompressed reference route.
Measured material bottleneck.
Local packing soundness and completeness theorem.
Mutation tests for width, index, truncation, and alias errors.
design_decisions.scope: Potential future performance optimization, not current correctness evidence.

design_decisions.reason: The sieve weights, factorial moments, admissible 50-tuple, variational quotient, Bombieri-Vinogradov premise, and the bound 246 have no typed mathematical map to any PID functional or estimator.
required_controls: Retain the rejection as a nontransfer firewall.
Reject shared-vocabulary arguments that cite factors, moments, lattices, or positivity without a mapping theorem.
design_decisions.scope: All PID mathematics and estimator claims.

evidence: PrimeGaps Bounded246 states a conditional prime-gap theorem; the SxPID3 packet states one deterministic empirical categorical functional.
findings: Only proof-engineering form transfers; the estimands and conclusions remain disjoint.
lens_review.name: Estimand
nonimplications: No prime-gap definition, inequality, or numerical constant becomes a PID object.

evidence: PrimeGaps separates labelled JSON, packed Nat data, explicit rational certificates, analytic L2 witnesses, and theorem hypotheses.
The proposed PID design separately types count rows, semantic masses, rational plans, intervals, reports, and dispositions.
findings: Typed object boundaries are strongly transferable.
lens_review.name: Types
nonimplications: Type separation alone does not establish faithful paper-to-formula correspondence.

evidence: The final Lean theorem keeps BombieriVinogradov as an explicit premise and uses an existential finite certificate.
The SxPID3 design fixes one finite empirical input before making per-coordinate conclusions.
findings: Conditionality and quantifier order must remain visible in reports and APIs.
lens_review.name: Quantifiers
nonimplications: An existential exact certificate is not a universal algorithmic, population, or statistical theorem.

evidence: No theorem maps the GPY/Maynard variational objects, factorial moments, or prime tuple to shared-exclusions PID.
findings: The only permitted mapping is between assurance roles, not mathematical values or propositions.
lens_review.name: Mappings
nonimplications: Similar words or diagram shapes do not license cross-domain theorem transfer.

evidence: PrimeGaps analytic support and measure premises are specific to its simplex and sieve argument.
SxPID3 uses positive empirical support and explicitly excludes continuous, singular, mixed-dimensional, or unknown-support laws.
findings: Support conditions must be reconstructed from the target method, never inherited from the source analogy.
lens_review.name: Support/reference measure
nonimplications: A finite categorical certificate supplies no absolute-continuity or KSG support evidence.

evidence: The SxPID3 packet independently specifies exactly 18 antichains, entrywise redundancy order, 129 zeta ones, and a 65-nonzero integer inverse.
The proposed graph uses stable antichain keys rather than implementation positions.
findings: Sparse completeness and stable-key reconstruction are appropriate for the exact three-source lattice.
lens_review.name: Lattice/source count
nonimplications: PrimeGaps signatures and the SxPID antichain lattice are different mathematical carriers.

evidence: SxPID3 fixes natural logarithms and nats; PrimeGaps certificate inequalities are dimensionless exact rationals in a different problem.
findings: The report states units separately and permits no numerical conversion between domains.
lens_review.name: Units/gauge
nonimplications: A positive rational margin in PrimeGaps is not a PID information value or error bound.

evidence: The SxPID3 target is the deterministic functional of one finite empirical PMF; its packet excludes population inference and binary64 estimator correctness.
findings: Exact empirical arithmetic, estimator output, and population quantity remain separate layers.
lens_review.name: Population/empirical
nonimplications: Exact empirical SxPID does not establish unbiasedness, consistency, or scientific generalization.

evidence: The narrow SxPID3 certificate implication is deterministic conditional on canonical count bytes and makes no sampling claim.
findings: Sampling assumptions become mandatory only for a later population or inferential claim.
lens_review.name: Sampling
nonimplications: This N/A disposition cannot be reused by a bootstrap, permutation, confidence, or population route.

evidence: PrimeGaps records a successful exact candidate but not a complete selection, stopping, or alternative-candidate ledger.
The PID workflow already requires pre-registered candidate and judge boundaries, exposure logs, and fresh confirmation where empirical selection is involved.
findings: Autoresearch can generate witnesses and implementation candidates, but selection effects need their own records.
lens_review.name: Selection/UQ
nonimplications: Repeated rediscovery, model consensus, or a selected exact witness does not establish search completeness or statistical calibration.

evidence: PrimeGaps contains an explicit-to-abstract Lean bridge, but the public paper graph uses mutable links and has status/link mismatches.
SxPID3 still requires a pinned independent MGW paper-to-formula source map.
findings: Formal correspondence is load-bearing and remains open for the target PID claim.
lens_review.name: Formal correspondence
nonimplications: A kernel proof of a convenient formal statement does not establish the intended paper semantics.

evidence: PrimeGaps pins Lean and resolved dependencies in its manifest and declares comparator axiom allowlists.
The reviewed CI did not run comparator, leanchecker, or nanoda and preserved no such receipt; one dependency is requested from mutable main.
findings: The architecture is useful, but the inspected public qualification is incomplete.
lens_review.name: Kernel/axioms/toolchain
nonimplications: A successful lake build does not prove comparator replay, axiom closure, or a fresh dependency reconstruction.

evidence: PrimeGaps direct formulas, packed kernels, and optional comparator diversify some implementation cuts but share the mathematical interpretation and certificate data.

findings: Independence is a vector, not a route count. External human and custody dimensions remain open.
lens_review.name: Route dependency diversity
nonimplications: Different files, agents, solvers, or kernels do not remove a shared wrong source interpretation.

evidence: PrimeGaps converts an approximate search result into an exact rational inequality.
SxPID3 separates exact rational sign from directed logarithm magnitude and explicitly excludes current Rust binary64 certification.
findings: The exact-search replacement pattern transfers only to finite algebraic obligations.
lens_review.name: Numerical/binary64
nonimplications: Exact rational PID products do not certify floating estimators, interval implementations, or platform math libraries.

evidence: Current SxPID3 specialized, general, feature, debug, release, platform, and Python paths have not been keyed against all 108 exact identities.
findings: An audit-only semantic trace and bound-binary replay are still required.
lens_review.name: Compiled/wrapper parity
nonimplications: A formal factor-DAG theorem cannot by itself establish Rust, Python, serialization, or error-surface conformance.

evidence: The SxPID3 packet retains event, mask-order, weighting, exact-zero, product-one, and negative-net witnesses.
The proposed attack matrix adds DAG alias, sparse-completeness, shard, resource, parser, formal, and claim-language mutations.
findings: The final implementation must demonstrate causal rejection under normal and optimized execution.
lens_review.name: Counterexample/mutation
nonimplications: Passing the named mutations does not prove completeness of the mutation model.

evidence: PrimeGaps has no reviewed release artifact, comparator receipt, certificate provenance digest, or external-custody replay.
The PID plan requires candidate-inaccessible judges, refusal on unavailable verification, and separate archive custody.
findings: Local hashes and same-environment councils are insufficient for high-assurance custody.
lens_review.name: Custody/threat/refusal
nonimplications: Provider availability or a public repository does not prove durable retention or independent review.

evidence: PrimeGaps cites its analytic and numerical origins and marks its repository as a formalization.
The PID packet distinguishes paper-defined MGW mathematics from project-defined certificate and workflow infrastructure.
findings: The process distinction transfers; no scientific novelty is claimed for the assurance design.
lens_review.name: Citations/novelty
nonimplications: Implementation, composition, or proof-engineering novelty is not a new PID theorem or estimator.

evidence: The PrimeGaps paper graph is useful for navigation but lacks a same-revision immutable receipt and contains mutable source links.

findings: A revision-pinned evidence DAG should replace status inferred from a mutable website projection.
lens_review.name: Ecosystem/authority
nonimplications: A status badge, linked declaration, or site graph does not itself accept a scientific claim.

evidence: PrimeGaps demonstrates useful theory/certificate build separation and packed computation, but the reviewed CI is warm-cache, minimal, and receipt-free.
The SxPID3 packet fixes exact parser, term, exponent, projected-bit, memory, and corpus limits.
findings: Simple streaming correctness, content-addressed shards, fresh replay, release artifacts, and external archive remain required before acceptance.
lens_review.name: Resource/platform/release
nonimplications: Fast cached execution does not establish cold reproducibility, platform scope, or durable evidence.

nontransfer_firewalls: Prime-gap mathematics, constants, tuple data, factorial moments, and Bombieri-Vinogradov reasoning have no PID mathematical transfer.
An exact finite categorical product certificate does not establish continuous shared exclusions, KSG support, KSG consistency, bias, variance, calibration, or confidence coverage.
A deterministic interval enclosing one empirical functional is not a statistical confidence interval.
A fitted or fixed quantizer changes or fixes an estimand and cannot establish equivalence with an unquantized continuous estimand without a separate theorem.
Formal proof checks the encoded theorem under its imports and axioms; paper-to-formal faithfulness is a separate reviewed obligation.
Source hashes and CI success bind bytes and one execution; they do not establish truth, authenticity, novelty, external custody, or long-term availability.
Agent, prompt, session, solver, or kernel multiplicity does not establish independence when load-bearing assumptions or custody are shared.
open_obligations: Preserve and adjudicate the unpublished SX-CERTIFIED-AVERAGED-PID3-001 packet on a reviewed main descendant before implementation.
Complete an independent pinned MGW paper-to-formula source map for event, component, averaging, units, and order semantics.
Decide whether the semantic mass DAG is internal revision-1 machinery or an acceptance-bearing claim-v2 object.
Implement and separately review the semantic mass DAG, reduced-rational plan, forward/backward completeness, and exact evaluation bridge.
Implement the concrete Lean carrier/event/product route and an independently encoded SMT finite route with mutation models.
Implement dependency-disjoint producer and verifier paths without shared event, lattice, product, or generated graph code.
Add a bound audit-only Rust semantic trace and reconcile specialized, general, feature, build, platform, and Python paths by stable key.
Freeze canonical corpus ordinals, execute all 20,348 tables and 2,197,584 coordinate verdicts in content-addressed shards, and prove coverage.
Obtain fresh-extraction, first-result, mutation, binary/toolchain, release, and independent-custody records before any accepted disposition.
Keep every population, statistical, continuous, KSG, and binary64 claim open unless a separately typed route supplies its own evidence.

changed_assumptions: PrimeGaps theory concerns a sieve argument and an analytic number-theory hypothesis; PID theory concerns a finite empirical information functional.
The PID composite must additionally bind source semantics, units, lattice order, exact products, intervals, and executable refinement.
transfer_entries.pid_analogue: Separate the paper-defined SxPID3 semantics and general lemmas, the exact finite certificate data, and the theorem or report that combines them for one bound input.
preserved_assumptions: Every lane is typed and independently buildable.
The composite references the exact same source revision and refuses stale or mixed evidence.
A passing component lane does not silently qualify the composite.
prohibited_inferences: Theory and certificate success separately imply the final PID claim without a checked bridge.
The prime-gap theorem or finite values have PID content.
transfer_entries.rationale: The separation improves reviewability and failure localization while preserving explicit bridge obligations.
required_evidence: Same-commit source and artifact identities.

changed_assumptions: SxPID3 candidate data are event masses and rational log products, not polynomial sieve coefficients or factorial moments.
The PID verifier must reconstruct the 18-node event lattice and 108-coordinate registry from canonical input.
Unlike an existential witness route, a PID result is a deterministic function of the exact count table, so parser fidelity and rejection of integer coercions are acceptance-bearing.
transfer_entries.pid_analogue: Let search, autoresearch, and generators propose count tables, near-zero examples, graph layouts, or product plans; accept only output independently reconstructed by a smaller exact checker.
preserved_assumptions: Candidate generation is untrusted.
The checker derives its result from a frozen mathematical specification and canonical input.
Generated compression or tables receive no authority without local soundness checks.
prohibited_inferences: A generator's self-check or repeated candidate rediscovery supplies independent verification.
The PrimeGaps kernel can be reused as a PID kernel without new semantics and soundness lemmas.
A decoder that happens to produce some valid witness is acceptable for PID when it changes the submitted data semantics.
transfer_entries.rationale: This is the strongest transferable architecture: exploratory computation retains freedom while promotion has a narrow exact trust boundary.
required_evidence: Separate producer and verifier dependency graphs.
Exact source and input identities.
Strict canonical decoding that rejects negative-to-natural coercion, aliases, duplicate members, and noncanonical serialization.
Semantic, graph, arithmetic, parser, resource, and reseal mutations.

transfer_entries.pid_analogue: Prove that semantic mass exponents evaluate to the local ratios, cumulative plans evaluate to Q, Mobius plans evaluate to R, and exact product comparison plus a directed log route yields each declared coordinate.
preserved_assumptions: The finite representation and the semantic object are separate types.
A named bridge proves correspondence rather than relying on matching output.

prohibited_inferences: Exact product equality alone establishes logarithm enclosure.

transfer_entries.rationale: This prevents the most common certificate error: verifying a convenient finite surrogate without proving it denotes the intended scientific object.
